basic_details.offering_entity: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (MEAE) & Campus France
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: All accredited French Universities and Grandes Écoles (Sorbonne, École Polytechnique, PSL, Paris-Saclay, Sciences Po, CentraleSupélec, INSA)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Seven priority study fields: Science and Technology (Biology and Health, Ecological Transition, Mathematics and Digital, Engineering Sciences), and Humanities and Social Sciences (French History, Language and Civilization, Law and Political Science, Economics and Management).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~350 to 400 scholarships awarded annually across 100+ countries
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open to Pakistan; numerous Pakistani scholars selected annually for French Grandes Écoles and research universities
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Master's: 12 to 36 months depending on entry level (M1 or M2); PhD: up to 36 months (or 6-18 months for joint-supervision cotutelle)

nationality_requirements: Non-French nationality (Pakistani citizens eligible; dual French citizens strictly ineligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Master's candidates: maximum 27 years of age at the time of application; PhD candidates: maximum 32 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 16 years of education (Bachelor's) for Master's; 18 years (Master's with research thesis) for PhD from an HEC-recognized institution.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.30 / 4.00 CGPA or equivalent; admitted candidates typically rank in the top 5% of their graduating class.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Academic background aligned with one of the 7 designated priority areas.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of degree in home country.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: None, provided age criteria are respected.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Academic excellence, scientific publications, and international outlook prioritized.

english_proficiency.notes: Language requirement depends on the chosen program; English-taught programs require IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+; French-taught programs require DELF/DALF B2/C1.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: French not mandatory for programs taught 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates CANNOT apply directly; they MUST be selected and nominated by a French higher education institution.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have previously received an Eiffel scholarship at the same degree level, or another French government scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: Eiffel does NOT pay tuition fees; however, nominating French public universities waive international tuition fees for Eiffel recipients; Grandes Écoles often waive or subsidize remaining fees.

admission_application_fee.details: Managed directly by nominating French institution.

accommodation.details: Campus France reserves public student housing (CROUS) for Eiffel scholars; rent is paid from monthly living allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Generous monthly maintenance allowance paid directly to student.
monthly_stipend.amount: Master's: €1,181 / month (~PKR 355,000 / month); PhD: €1,800 / month (~PKR 540,000 / month)

airfare.details: Single round-trip international economy class flight between home country and France.

visa_fee.details: French student visa application fee waived by the French Embassy for Eiffel scholars.

health_insurance.details: Campus France provides private health insurance until enrollment in the free French National Health Insurance (Sécurité Sociale).

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Cultural activities, excursions, and travel within France organized and funded by Campus France.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Domestic train travel from Paris airport to host university city fully covered.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single French higher education institution (University or Grande École).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Premier French research universities and elite Grandes Écoles.
available_majors: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biotechnology, Health Sciences, Renewable Energy, Environmental Sciences, Economics, Management, Law, Political Science
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master's: 1 to 2 years; PhD: up to 3 years
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Must apply to a French institution; the institution selects top candidates and submits the Eiffel dossier on their behalf to Campus France.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: French institutions have internal pre-selection deadlines (typically October-November); early contact is essential.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Focus on high-ranking English-taught Master's degrees at Paris-Saclay, Sorbonne, or Institut Polytechnique de Paris.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Campus France Eiffel Online Institutional Platform
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Candidates cannot submit applications directly. You must contact the international relations office or program director of your chosen French university.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Identify eligible master's or PhD programs at French universities/Grandes Écoles (September-October).
2. Contact the French university's international relations office expressing interest in Eiffel nomination.
3. Submit required application materials to the French institution before their internal deadline (usually November).
4. If accepted and selected, the French institution completes and submits the official Eiffel application to Campus France by early January.
5. Campus France scientific committees evaluate institutional dossiers in February/March.
6. Results published on the Campus France website in early April.
7. Selected scholars contact Campus France to arrange airfare and visa formalities.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Institutional nomination: Candidate applies to French university; university submits Eiffel dossier to Campus France.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted to the nominating French institution.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Demonstrate academic excellence, international career objectives, and justification for choosing France.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD candidates must submit a 1 to 5-page research project endorsed by the French thesis director.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Curriculum Vitae (in French or English) emphasizing academic honors, rank in class, and publications (1-2 pages).
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: French university admissions teams conduct video interviews prior to nominating candidates for Eiffel.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: English test (IELTS/TOEFL) for English programs, or French test (DELF/DALF) for French programs.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: $0 for Eiffel; some Grandes Écoles may have application fees.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified copies of degree certificates and transcripts; HEC attestation required.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official certified translations into French or English.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Submitted online by the nominating French institution via the Campus France portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official institutional dossier completed and signed by French university rector/president
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Submitted directly by the French university to Campus France

required_documents_checklist.specification: Transcripts showing all grades, GPA, and official certificate of class rank
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan; rank in class is crucial for Eiffel selection

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1-2 page CV in English or French
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlighting academic awards, research projects, and publications

required_documents_checklist.specification: Personal statement explaining career vision and reasons for studying in France
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clear narrative on how French expertise will impact career

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+) for English programs

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: French universities' internal deadlines are between late October and late November. Final Campus France submission deadline is early January; results released in early April.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Academic excellence, class ranking, reputation of home university)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Quality of French institution's endorsement and international strategy)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Campus France scientific expert committees composed of leading French university professors and researchers.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Three criteria: Candidate excellence (40%), Institutional international policy (30%), MEAE geographical priority balance (30%).

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,500 institutional nominations submitted by French universities (from thousands of applicants)
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_global: ~25% of institutionally nominated candidates (~2% to 3% of total applicants)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top students from prestigious Pakistani universities with strong foundational training, international publications, and clear career plans.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, LUMS, GIKI, FAST, Quaid-i-Azam University who secured admission to top French institutions.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Global distribution across Asia, Latin America, Middle East, Africa, Eastern Europe.

fake_websites_and_scams: Websites claiming to accept direct Eiffel applications from students; direct applications are automatically disqualified.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Campus France does NOT charge any fee for the Eiffel scholarship.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never use agents; applications MUST be submitted by the French university itself.
hidden_costs_breakdown: CVEC student life and campus contribution fee (~€100, though Eiffel scholars are exempt, initial paperwork required).
Grandes Écoles tuition fee difference if not fully waived by the school.
Initial pocket money before first monthly stipend transfer in France.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You can submit the application directly to Campus France. (Fact: Applications must be submitted exclusively by a French higher education institution).
MYTH: You must speak fluent French. (Fact: Hundreds of eligible programs are taught 100% in English).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Many blogs claim Eiffel covers full tuition fees; officially, Eiffel does NOT pay tuition fees; it relies on university tuition waivers.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must pass all courses and obtain the degree within the normal period (60 ECTS credits per year).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical attendance at host French institution.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Host institutions report academic results annually to Campus France.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work up to 60% of annual legal work time (approx 964 hours/year) under French student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are eligible for the French Job Seeker / Business Creation Residence Permit (RECE) for 1 year post-graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Failing courses or abandoning studies leads to immediate scholarship termination.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Strictly prohibited; the scholarship is awarded to the specific institution that nominated the student.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: No extensions granted beyond the initial grant duration.
